channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Entry points that route messages into agents. Saves go to the deployment config and bind at the next runtime start.
channels.apiMissing: This runtime does not expose the Studio channels API yet; rebuild and restart AgentFlow, then reopen Channels.
channels.pendingRestart: {n, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} · restart required
channels.readOnlyMessage: This deployment's channels cannot be edited from Studio.
channels.needAgentMessage: A channel must route messages to an existing agent. Create an agent, then add the channel.
channels.deleteMessage:
Delete "{name}" from the deployment config?

The running instance keeps it until the next restart.
channels.fileChangedMessage:
{message}

Nothing was deleted. Reload the channel list?
channels.listReloadedReopen: channel list reloaded · reopen the channel to edit it
channels.emptyGuidance: Create a channel to route messages into an agent.
channels.noConfigPath: This runtime did not report a channels config path.
channels.editorSubtitle: Route inbound messages into an agent. Changes take effect on the next runtime start.
channels.valid: Valid. Restart the runtime to bind it.
channels.reloadedSaveAgain: Channel list reloaded. Save again to add the channel.
channels.conflictEdit: Reloading closes this dialog: reopen the channel to edit the version on disk.
channels.conflictNew: Nothing was saved. Reload the list, then save again.
channels.asyncReply: Async (202 + job id instead of a blocking reply)
channels.hint.agentsExposed: Comma-separated. A client selects one by name as its model.
channels.hint.agentsExposedDesktop: Comma-separated. A client selects one by name as its model. The Agent field above is ignored for this type.
channels.hint.staleAgent: Agent "{name}" no longer exists. Choose the agent this channel routes to.
channels.hint.pathBridge: Path is required for a bridge and must end with /.
channels.hint.pathDefault: Optional route on the shared listener. An explicit path must end with /.
channels.hint.telegramMode: Webhook and auto modes need gateway.public_url. Polling ignores the path.
channels.hint.allowedUsers: Comma-separated numeric IDs; empty accepts anyone the bot can see.
channels.hint.appId: From the bot's page on the QQ Open Platform (q.qq.com).
channels.hint.appSecret: Fetches the access token and verifies webhook callbacks.
channels.hint.qqCredentialsDesktop: From the bot's page on the QQ Open Platform (q.qq.com). The secret signs webhook callbacks and fetches the access token.
channels.hint.qqWebhook: Set <public https url><path> as the callback URL in the console (ports 80, 443, 8080 or 8443).
channels.hint.qqWebhookDesktop: Set <public https url><path> as the callback URL in the console (ports 80, 443, 8080 or 8443). Path defaults to /webhook/qq/<name>/.
channels.hint.qqWebsocket: The runtime connects out to the QQ gateway; nothing needs to be reachable from the internet.
channels.hint.qqWebsocketDesktop: The runtime connects out to the QQ gateway; nothing needs to be reachable from the internet. Leave Path empty.
channels.hint.scenes: Guild DMs need an intent the platform grants on application.
channels.hint.replies: Private chats and groups only; the platform grants markdown per bot. A refused markdown reply is resent as plain text.
channels.hint.githubSecret: Required. The HMAC signature is the only thing authenticating a delivery.
channels.hint.replyTimeout: Default 55s. Raise it for pipelines that outrun a single turn.
channels.hint.deliverUrl: The adapter receives neutral replies here as JSON. Absolute http(s) URL.
channels.hint.deliveryTimeout: Default 10s. The adapter must answer each delivery within it.
channels.hint.inboundSecret: Required. The adapter signs each inbound body with X-Agentflow-Signature.
channels.hint.outboundToken: Optional. Sent as Authorization: Bearer when delivering to the adapter.
channels.hint.authUserToken: Per-user bearer tokens issued by the identity layer; runtime.identity.enabled must be on. Stored shared keys are removed on save.
channels.hint.authNone: No auth: only allowed when gateway.listen is a loopback address. Stored shared keys are removed on save.
channels.hint.apiKeys: Bearer keys clients send, comma-separated. ${VAR} and cred:<service> references are resolved at start.
channels.hint.journal: metadata keeps ids and sizes and never the conversation text; full keeps text; off writes nothing.
channels.hint.requestTimeout: Default 600s for the whole request, including tool rounds.
channels.hint.maxRequestBytes: Empty or 0 uses the default, 32 MiB.
channels.hint.exposeReasoning: Exposing reasoning shows the model's thinking to the caller; off by default.
channels.hint.mediaAllow: Comma-separated, e.g. image/*, application/pdf. Empty disables attachments.
channels.hint.mediaMax: Defaults to 8 MiB when media is enabled.
channels.placeholder.keepStoredValue: leave blank to keep the stored value
channels.placeholder.keepStoredKeys: leave blank to keep the stored keys
channels.error.allowUserNotNumeric: allow users: "{value}" is not a numeric id
channels.error.maxRequestBytes: max request bytes must be a whole number, 0 or more
channels.error.mediaMax: max bytes must be a positive integer
channels.telegram.pollingLiveHint: Polling mode goes live immediately when you save — no restart needed.
channels.telegram.verifyHint: Verify bot identity and Privacy Mode before saving.
channels.telegram.privacyOnDesc: Telegram hides ordinary group messages from bots with Privacy Mode on. It receives @-mentions and direct replies by default; run /setprivacy -> Disable in @BotFather if you want trigger phrases or all-message context.
channels.telegram.privacyOffDesc: Bot can read all group messages where it is a member (trigger phrases and optional group context work out of the box).
channels.qq.websocketLiveHint: Websocket mode goes live immediately when you save — no restart needed.
channels.qq.verifyHint: Verify AppID, AppSecret, and IP allowlist access before saving.
channels.qq.groupAllHint: Group @-mentions arrives by default. Add group_all only if your QQ bot has full group-message permission.
channels.emailMarkSeen: Mark processed inbound emails as read (\Seen)
channels.hint.emailMode: idle uses IMAP IDLE push (with polling fallback); polling checks on an interval.
channels.hint.mailbox: IMAP folder to monitor; defaults to INBOX.
channels.hint.smtpUsername: Optional. Defaults to the IMAP username.
channels.hint.smtpPassword: Optional. Defaults to the IMAP password.
channels.hint.fromAddress: Optional display/address header for outgoing replies (defaults to SMTP username).
channels.hint.pollInterval: Default 30s. Used in polling mode and as the IDLE sync interval.
channels.hint.allowFrom: Comma-separated sender addresses. When Allowed senders and Allowed domains are both empty, all senders are allowed.
channels.hint.allowDomains: Comma-separated sender domains (e.g. example.com). Matches senders from either list.
channels.hint.emailMarkSeen: Marks accepted messages \Seen after dispatch so they are not reprocessed on restart.
channels.placeholder.emailPassword: IMAP password or app password, e.g. ${EMAIL_PASSWORD}
channels.error.invalidPort: port must be a whole number between 1 and 65535
channels.email.liveHint: Email polling or IDLE starts immediately when you save — no restart needed.
